name: updateTableAggregation
description: Updates an aggregation in a Tulip Table by the aggregation id. Corresponds to PUT /tables/{tableId}/aggregation/{aggregationId}. Requires `table-queries:write` scope. [WRITE]

tableId.description: The id of a Tulip Table.

aggregationId.description: The id of a Tulip Table aggregation.

field.description: Column name from getTable .columns[].name (not the label).
